map.依据《民法典》婚姻家庭编计算夫妻共同财产分割: Computes the division of marital community property under the Marriage and Family Book of the Civil Code
map.📖 查看「离婚财产分割计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Divorce Property Division Calculator User Guide"
map.离婚共同财产分割 =（婚后工资奖金、生产经营收益、投资收益、知识产权收益等共同财: Division of community property on divorce = (community property such as post-marital wages and bonuses, income from production and business, investment income and IP income − joint debts) ÷ 2; pre-marital separate property and compensation for personal injury are excluded; the party caring for the children, the wife, or the spouse without fault may receive a somewhat larger share.
map.有婚前财产协议: There is a prenuptial property agreement
map.工资、奖金、生产经营收益、知识产权收益、继承或赠与所得财产（明确只归一方的除外）: Wages, bonuses, income from production and business, IP income, and property acquired by inheritance or gift, except where it is expressly for one spouse only
map.婚前财产、一方因受到人身损害获得的赔偿、遗嘱或赠与合同中确定只归一方的财产、一方: Pre-marital property, compensation received by a spouse for personal injury, property designated by will or gift contract for one spouse only, and articles for the personal use of one spouse
map.按照顾子女、女方和无过错方权益的原则判决: Judgment follows the principle of protecting the children, the wife and the spouse without fault
map.重婚、与他人同居、家暴、虐待遗弃等情形，无过错方有权请求损害赔偿: In cases of bigamy, cohabitation with another, domestic violence, abuse or abandonment, the spouse without fault may claim damages
map.协议离婚时，按双方约定的分割比例快速拆分共同财产总额。: In divorce by agreement, split the total community property quickly at the ratio the parties agreed.
map.存在婚前财产、父母出资等情形的，先剥离个人财产再分割共同部分。: Where there is pre-marital property or parental contributions, carve out the separate property first, then divide the community part.
map.对房产、存款、理财等逐项按比列分配，形成可签署的财产分割方案。: Allocate property, deposits and investments item by item by ratio to produce a signable division plan.
map.夫妻共同财产合计 200 万元，约定我方 60%、对方 40%：我方得 120: Community property totals ¥2,000,000, with 60% to me and 40% to the other spouse: ¥1,200,000 and ¥800,000 respectively.
map.剥离婚前财产后分割: Dividing after carving out pre-marital property
map.总资产 300 万中婚前个人房产 100 万不计入，可分割共同财产 200 万；: Of ¥3,000,000 total assets, ¥1,000,000 of pre-marital property is excluded, leaving ¥2,000,000 of community property to divide; a prenuptial agreement takes priority.
map.婚前首付婚后共同还贷的房产怎么分？: How is a home divided when one spouse paid the deposit before marriage and both repaid the loan afterwards?
map.通常房产归登记方，婚后共同还贷及对应增值部分作为共同财产分割，由取得房产一方对另: The home usually goes to the registered owner, while the joint repayments after marriage and the corresponding increase in value are divided as community property, with the owner compensating the other spouse in cash.
map.协议离婚自愿约定即可，不要求均等；诉讼离婚原则上均等，但会照顾子女、女方和无过错: In divorce by agreement the parties may set any ratio; equality is not required. In contested divorce the starting point is equality, adjusted to protect the children, the wife and the spouse without fault.
